claims.claim_text: Davis L Cook's printed identifier conflicts with the official Army merged file: it selects a different name, while an exact-name Davis L Cook row differs by one digit.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The complete bulk-file scan exposes two incompatible candidates and supplies no authority to correct the OSS index or merge either Army row.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting; project rules prohibit transferring facts across a different name or different private identifier without direct evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: No Army-entry date, occupation, rank or employer is assigned to the indexed person until Box 140 or an original record resolves the conflict.
claims.match_notes: Both full identifiers, the unrelated name and both raw Army rows remain private. The index value is preserved literally rather than silently changed.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 91 and complete Army comparison; exact-name OSS/CIA, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, current Library of Congress, directory and archival checks for Charles O Cook.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Multiple exact-name Army rows carry different identifiers. Five Library of Congress pages contain no exact-name OCR phrase, and public obituaries or directories lack an OSS or Box 140 bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. The unresolved identity remains visible.
